chapter: Trent's band: touring, sidemen and breakup
title: Hilliard joins in Texas; trouble over a bandmate's wife
summary: Hilliard from San Antonio, who played three instruments, joined after the Plaza Hotel; the band confronts him about a member's wife.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Now Hilliard joined in Texas, didn't he?

I'm trying to think, because there was something that Crooke told me, Crooke said that there was at one time Herschel Edwards could have joined the band but everybody liked Lee Hilliard because he played three instruments. He played trumpet and clarinet and saxophone.
That's right. Equally well. But he joined us in Texas.
He's from San Antonio, he joined us when--when we played the Plaza Hotel, because he's not on that picture, but he joined us right after that.
He was a hell of a man, too.
He wasn't hard to get along with?
had with him, he wanted to go with one of the guys' wife in the band and that's something we didn't allow.
No. We even had a meeting with him and said that either he had to stop or we would fire him.
